title: Irreducible refinement of a lisse stratification
statement: Let X be Noetherian, F a sheaf of sets on X, and S a finite stratification such that F is finite locally constant on every stratum. Then there is a finite stratification T whose strata are irreducible and on which F remains finite locally constant.

proof.text: Choose an irreducible topological refinement T of S, retaining its refinement witness. Apply finite-local-constancy preservation to that witness and hS. Pair the irreducibility and finite-local-constancy assertions for each stratum of T. The refinement-preservation node is realized by the proved upstream declaration in WeilConjectures.AlgebraicGeometry.RefinementPreservesFiniteLisse, imported directly; its finite-locally-constant predicate is definitionally the lisse predicate used here.

proof_origin.place: exists_irreducible_refinement: obtain T and pair its two properties

mathlib_searches.query: finite stratification irreducible locally closed refinement

lean.statement: theorem exists_irreducible_refinement (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1))) (S : Stratification X) (hS : ∀ i : Fin S.n, IsFiniteLocallyConstantEtaleSheafOfSets ((etaleSetPullback (S.immersion i)).obj F)) : ∃ T : Stratification X, ∀ i : Fin T.n, IrreducibleSpace (T.domain i) ∧ IsFiniteLocallyConstantEtaleSheafOfSets ((etaleSetPullback (T.immersion i)).obj F)
